title: Acha, brother of Abba, father of Rabbi Yirmiyah bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Shabbat 56b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.56b.18), where Rav says, “There is none greater among penitents in our generation”—who is he? Abba, father of Rabbi Yirmiyah bar Abba. Others identify the penitent as Acha, Abba’s brother. As the master said, Abba and Acha were brothers.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Abba and Acha are brothers and are given as alternative answers. “Father of Rabbi Yirmiyah bar Abba” describes Abba.
Hyman abbreviates the comparison. Rav first names Josiah in his generation and then identifies a counterpart in his own generation.
